newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists positive again on AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists positive again on AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists moved from a mainly neutral to a positive stance on the AEX share index on Monday, forecasting it would keep pushing higher.
They set the initial target for the index of 30 leading shares at 700 points, described by ABN AMRO as a psychological resistance level, with the next level between 715 and 720.
"The six week rising trend has been resumed," said ING Barings, which had a neutral view the previous week.
The index ended at a record closing high of 694.25 last Friday, up 18.57 points on a week earlier. In the week before, the index had fallen one point.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ING Barings - Last week's break of the AEX above horizontal resistance at 686 has ended the market's sluggish scenario of the previous two weeks. The six week rising trend has been resumed. Rising momentum confirms upside potential. Money flow of the AEX remains bullish, suggesting active guying. Advance/ decline ratios are rising steeply, indicating that leadership in the market is picking up. Current technicals indicate initial objective of around 700, next target comes in around 715. A fall below 682 would violate the underlying trend.

ABN AMRO - In our last comment we wrote: "Our first target still is the psychological resistance level of 700. Our medium term target lies around 720." At the moment that scenario has been effected, therefore we stick to that statement. The wedge which was taken out last week confirmed the scenario with prices around 720 in the near future. In our view, the index has succeeded in sustaining a clear direction in the medium term. Therefore, staying long is the best strategy. The possible dips in the market are still buying-opportunities. This view is supported by the wide range of individual stocks which are worth buying.

IRIS - Breaking to new highs has confirmed the uptrend in the AEX. There are no former highs to serve as resistance levels but trendline resistance is coming in around 710. Current trend weakens when rising trendline around 680 gives way.
